serviceKeyPresets.name: Read
serviceKeyPresets.use: Read every project surface through Hue MCP, including recorded trace content.

serviceKeyPresets.name: Read and write
serviceKeyPresets.use: Read and write every project surface: MCP tools, tracing, evaluations, artifacts, captures and simulated environments. Billing stays in the app.

serviceKeyPresets.name: Tracing only
serviceKeyPresets.use: Send OpenTelemetry traces and verify known trace IDs. Use this key on production application servers.

mcp.authentication: OAuth 2.1 authorization code with PKCE, discovered from the endpoint's protected-resource metadata and the issuer's authorization-server metadata, or a Bearer project service key

product.runtime: dynamic Node.js route in the Fern Vercel application

providerFacade.releaseBoundary: The route is mounted, but official production provider registrations are empty; Gmail and Slack are not released capabilities.

evaluate.title: Run your agent against a case

installSnippets.oauthClaudeCodeCli: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user hue 'https://mcp.hue.run/mcp?toolsets=all'
installSnippets.claudeCodeCli:
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user hue 'https://mcp.hue.run/mcp?toolsets=all' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${HUE_MCP_KEY}'
installSnippets.geminiCli:
gemini mcp add --scope user --transport http hue https://mcp.hue.run/mcp \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer ${HUE_MCP_KEY}'
installSnippets.oauthConnectPrompt: Connect this coding agent to Hue MCP at https://mcp.hue.run/mcp using browser sign-in, with no API key. Use curl to read https://docs.hue.run/agents/mcp-server.md and follow it.
installSnippets.connectPrompt:
Connect me to Hue MCP.

It is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) at https://mcp.hue.run/mcp. Authenticate with a bearer token read from the HUE_MCP_KEY environment variable — reference the variable, do not write the key into a config file.

Register it under the name "hue" using whatever MCP configuration my client uses, then call get_project_context and tell me which Hue project it reached.
installSnippets.verifyPrompt: Use Hue MCP: call list_projects and confirm which project to inspect. Then call get_project_context and show its 5 most recent error traces with links. For an organization connection, pass the project's id or slug as project_id on each call after list_projects.

simulationGateway.runtime: feature-flagged /api/sim catch-all in the Fern web artifact
simulationGateway.aliasRule: {alias} is the real host with every dot replaced by a dash, one DNS label
simulationGateway.releaseBoundary: The route is mounted and registers the Gmail MCP, Gmail REST, Slack Web API and Slack MCP mirrors. SIM_GATEWAY_ENABLED is on in staging and production; staging serves them for verification, and production answers on the application form. The gateway is not a released customer capability, so its status stays deployed_inactive. Production sim hosts are not configured. Customer documentation must not name a mirror host until docs/simulation-hosts.md records it as proven.
